competitiveTarget: Beat generic brokerage team pages: real broker names, OREA license numbers, transparent-PNG headshots, and direct phone/email, with zero invented track-record or review claims.
note: Wave 3 site-v2 rebuild. The broker grid renders ONLY verified getBrokers() data (name, title, license #, headshot, phone, email). No bios, stats, rankings, or track-record claims. No reviews UI until a verified review source is wired (D99). Each card links to the broker's profile via teamPath().

requiredComponents.name: HeroBlock
requiredComponents.section: hero — 'Meet the brokers.' + lede (three licensed brokers, no hand-offs) + canonical Old Mill photo

requiredComponents.name: BrokerCard
requiredComponents.section: team grid — featured cards for all brokers via getBrokers(), each linking to teamPath(slug)

requiredComponents.name: CTABar
requiredComponents.section: 'Ready to talk' — navy CTA band with schedule-a-call + phone
